body: DELTA REVIEW — e05300b over f390700 is test-only and does not clear the two blockers. It adds selection-placement assertions immediately before and at the chosen token end, which is useful V-L2 strengthening. But the test still never proves the positive-control shape token.endExclusive < containingSentence.endExclusive, never compiles Sentences at that same mid-sentence horizon, and never asserts the required Tokens OnMark / Sentences OffProjection pair. Without that capacity assertion it can degenerate to a sentence-final token and no longer kill hierarchical suppression. It also has no clipped-prefix sentence mutation. Production is byte-identical, so the F2 typed refusal/preflight remains absent.\n\nThe reported ordinal+1 mutation is good evidence for one exact-field check, but it is not a committed negative test and does not cover altered kind/span/parent or a foreign atlas. My f390700 type-discipline result remains clean; landing-blocker disposition remains unchanged for e05300b.
